chunks: Abu Basir narrated from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

Pray the Salat of Ja'far at whatever time you wish, by night or by day. If you wish, you may count it as part of the supererogatory prayers of the night, and if you wish, you may count it as part of the supererogatory prayers of the day. It will be counted for you as part of your supererogatory prayers, and it will be counted for you as the Salat of Ja'far عليه السلام.

key_terms.صَلَاةَ جَعْفَرٍ: The special recommended prayer associated with Ja'far عليه السلام
key_terms.نَوَافِلِ اللَّيْلِ: The supererogatory prayers performed at night
key_terms.نَوَافِلِ النَّهَارِ: The supererogatory prayers performed during the day

ai.seo_question: When can Salat of Ja'far be prayed, and can it be counted among the nawafil prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Salat of Ja'far may be performed at any time during the night or day. It also clarifies that it may be counted among the recommended nawafil prayers while still retaining its distinct merit as the Salat of Ja'far عليه السلام.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1539 - Abu Basir narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:

"Pray the Salat of Ja'far whenever you wish, be it during the day or night. If you wish, you may count it as part of the supererogatory prayers of the night, and if you wish, you may count it as part of the supererogatory prayers of the day. It will be counted as part of your supererogatory prayers and as the Salat of Ja'far (as)."
